gap: No result ChatGPT got states that switching a 70–80 lb, 24 V motor to the single 24 V 100Ah LiFePO4 battery ChatGPT recommends also means buying a 29.2 V charger: Minn Kota's own PCL onboard chargers top out at 14.5 V per 12 V bank, so the boat's existing two-bank charger cannot charge one 24 V block.
standout_why: I read the three pages ChatGPT cited. Minn Kota's Power Considerations page gives 110Ah per battery, 1/2/3 batteries for ≤55 / ≤80 / >80 lb, 10 AWG leads and the 85% speed cap on lithium. Its Deep Cycle Battery Selection page says to use Group 27 / 110Ah and to make sure the lithium continuous discharge covers the max draw, but the per-thrust draw figures are only in a chart image. The uncited Lithium Battery Selection result (#6) gives the MK 330PCL as 10 A per bank with a 14.5 V maximum and tells you to check the charge profile with the battery maker. None of them says that a single 24 V or 36 V lithium battery needs a charger at 29.2 V or 43.8 V instead of the per-bank 12 V charger already on the boat. None gives a figure such as Minn Kota's 60 A QUEST maximum to check a BMS against. ChatGPT's answer named no products and no charger. Result #6 does print the 14.5 V input, so the rivals hold part of this.
kit_items: Battery (70–80 lb, 24 V motor): Redodo 24V 100Ah Group 31 Bluetooth. It fits a Group 31 tray and replaces two 12 V AGMs wired in series, matching ChatGPT's '24V 100Ah' pick in one box

Charger (needed with the battery above): Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI LiFePO4 charger. A single 24 V LiFePO4 block needs 29.2 V, and a Minn Kota PCL bank gives at most 14.5 V. Redodo says it fully charges a 24V 100Ah in 5 h (100 Ah ÷ 20 A)
Alternative set (≤55 lb, 12 V motor): Redodo 12V 100Ah Trolling Motor battery (low-temp charge cutoff, 300 A for 5 s) plus Redodo 14.6V 20A LiFePO4 charger

Protection: a circuit breaker or inline fuse on the positive terminal, close to the battery, no larger than 60 A for QUEST motors (Minn Kota). I could not source a price for a breaker in an approved store
Avoid for a 36 V QUEST motor: Redodo 36V 50Ah. Its BMS is rated 50 A steady (60 A for 30 min), and Minn Kota says QUEST motors can draw up to 60 A on high speed
